title: bash gate refuses a redirect whose target is a shell variable, even when it expands to an always-writable path
detail: During solo_execute on the engine repo, a heredoc redirect to $S/probe_prusik.py, with S set to the session scratchpad under /private/tmp, was blocked: '$S/probe_prusik.py' not in writable patterns. The gate compares the unexpanded text, so the block reason and the suggested path (worktrees/solo/$S/probe_prusik.py) are both wrong for what the command would do. The Write tool to the same literal path succeeded. Failing closed on an unresolvable target is right; the message should say the target could not be resolved rather than name a path that is not the one written. Surfaced building v0.236.1.
